name: ASMPT Limited
summary: ASMPT Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of machines, tools, and materials used in the semiconductor and electronics assembly industries internationally. The company operates in two segments: Semiconductor Solutions and Surface Mount Technology Solutions. The company offers ASMPT semiconductor solutions includes advanced packing, such as laser dicing & grooving, fan out, hybrid bonding, thermos compress bonding, and die bonding; IC and discrete, including silver sintering, wire bonding, metrology, encapsulation, and singulation, trim & form; CMOS image sensor, such as inline solution, lens holder attach, curing, automated optical inspect…
